style: Read this in a calm, warm, low and unhurried male voice, like a premium product film narrator. Relaxed pacing, gentle pauses at commas, no excitement or sales tone:

lines.text: Every site starts with a question.
What can actually be built here?
Start with the property, and a sentence about what you have in mind.
Drafted locates the parcel, and shows you every lot around it, so you can confirm the right one.
Then it maps what's already there. Wetlands, flood zones, roads, and the area you can build on.
It reads the local ordinance. Setbacks, parking, permitted uses. And sizes a program that fits.
Then it lays out the site. Buildings, parking, curbs, landscaped islands, and a driveway that meets the road.
Every plan comes as a finished sheet, and as a CAD file you can keep working in.
From the plan, a 3D model. From the model, a photoreal render, set into its real surroundings.
And when you need to go further, a full due diligence package. Zoning, permitting, costs, and returns.
From a sentence, to a site plan.
